metaTitle: Custom Medium Headbands Wristbands | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom medium headbands and wristbands in bulk. Perfect for events, teams, and giveaways. Fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Medium-sized headbands and wristbands offer a versatile fit that works for most adults, making them a smart choice for bulk orders. Whether you need printed bandanas for a company picnic, tubular headbands for a 5K run, or fleece earbands for a winter promotion, the medium size ensures comfort across a wide range of recipients. Decorate with your logo using screen printing, dye sublimation, or full-color transfer to create a cohesive look for your team or event.
heroAltText: Stack of custom medium headbands and wristbands in assorted colors with printed logos, suitable for bulk orders.
